scripts.dev: pnpm dlx concurrently -n frontend,backend,agent -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:frontend" "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:agent"
scripts.dev:agent: cd packages/agent && uv run python -m src.infra_check && uv run langgraph dev --port 8123
scripts.dev:agent:mute: cd packages/agent && uv run python -m src.infra_check && uv run langgraph dev --port 8123 --no-reload
scripts.dev:agentLocal: cd packages/agent && PLAN2CODE_AGENT_CLI_MODE=1 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 uv run python -m src.cli
scripts.analysis:dry: uv run --project packages/agent python .cursor/skills/langsmith-cost-review/scripts/pull_langsmith_metrics.py --project plan2code-agent --days 7 --top 10 --write-docs --dry-run --version v1.1
scripts.analysis: uv run --project packages/agent python .cursor/skills/langsmith-cost-review/scripts/pull_langsmith_metrics.py --project plan2code-agent --days 7 --top 10 --write-docs --version v1.1
